name: CCTV camera plan symbol
summary: Plan symbol for a CCTV camera, drawn as a camera body with a lens and an optional field-of-view cone.
description: CCTV cameras are drawn as a small rectangle with a lens shape or a triangle, at their mounting position, often with a field-of-view cone. Fixed, dome and pan-tilt-zoom types are distinguished by letters or small changes in the shape.
Network cameras are commonly powered by PoE, so the plan symbol is linked to a data outlet and the network switch. The installer needs the mounting height and the target scene to aim the camera.
The cone is indicative. Resolution at the target distance is the real performance criterion and is not shown by the symbol.
readingNotes: Check field of view against the area to be covered.
Find the data outlet and PoE source.
distinction: An intruder motion detector senses presence; a camera records and transmits images.
